# `profile.pull`

Fetch the configured remote's head; refuses on divergent conflicting heads.

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice profile-pull`
- **MCP tool:** `profile_pull` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Examples

```
operator-voice profile-pull
```

_Synthesized from this operation's required arguments._

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |
| `local_only_no_backend` | You are in local-only mode with no private-Git backend bound, so this is a safe no-op. |
| `divergent_remote_head` | The remote history diverged from your last publish; the pull stops rather than force anything. |
